name: mkxp-z-vita
description: HardRPG: play RPG Maker XP, VX, VX Ace, 2000 and 2003 games on PS Vita.
long_description: Copy your games to the Vita and play them from a game library with covers. XP, VX and VX Ace games run natively on mkxp-z-vita, this repository's Vita port of mkxp-z. RPG Maker 2000 and 2003 games run on the EasyRPG Player that comes built in. RPG Maker Dante 98 and Dante 98 II games (the PC-98 RPG Makers) run natively on a built-in port of OpenDT. It is free, open source homebrew for any Vita with HENkaku or Ensō.
